title: Monday energizer
subtitle: ~28 min · outside + home · moderate effort, get the heart rate up
feeling: Slightly scratchy throat, taking non-drowsy allergy meds. A higher heart rate helps me feel calm and awake.
note: Keep it moderate, about 6 out of 10. Drink water before and after. If the air bothers your throat, breathe through your nose and wear a scarf. Stop and rest if you feel unwell.

items.name: Easy walk outside
items.cue: Loosen up and get your breathing going.

sections.label: 2 · Jog / walk intervals
sections.instructions: Outside. 2 min easy jog, then 1 min walk, 4 times.

items.name: Easy jog / walk
items.cue: Moderate effort, about 6 out of 10. You should still be able to talk in short sentences.

sections.label: 3 · Light strength · 2 rounds
sections.instructions: Do all 4 moves in a row. Rest 30 seconds. Repeat 2 times.

items.name: Goblet squat
items.cue: One 20 lb dumbbell held at your chest. Sit down and stand up with control.

items.name: Push-up
items.cue: Knees down is fine. Chest nearly to the floor.

items.name: One-arm row
items.cue: One 15-20 lb dumbbell. Free hand on a chair. Pull your elbow to your hip.

items.name: Glute bridge
items.cue: On your back, knees bent. Lift your hips and squeeze your glutes at the top.

items.name: Stretch and slow breathing
items.cue: Stretch hips, chest and neck. Breathe in through your nose, out slowly through your mouth.
